source_observer_metadata.native_hourly_definition: State immediately after hourly surface exchange and release. Sparse kg per native cell; ug/m3 = kg*1e9/(500*500*layer_thickness).
source_observer_metadata.daily_definition: 24 hourly endpoints averaged with mass/24 per particle, matching the frozen CPU baseline.
source_observer_metadata.trajectory_policy: Deterministic diagnostic subsample: stable ID modulo nper == 0. One primary per source/event; secondary IDs use same systematic rule. Not a full-count trajectory data set or a random/unbiased estimate.
source_observer_metadata.mass_accounting: Native fields contain all particles including the near region. Near queries and trajectories are views, never added to regional mass. Each segment occurs once with a 4-bit overlapping-envelope mask.
source_observer_metadata.near_envelope: Horizontal radius 500 m around each outlet, all modeled heights. Actual accepted reflected pieces including birth-to-first-step and lateral exits.
source_observer_metadata.loss_timing: Contact uptake at piece endpoints; wet/chemical loss at step end. Terrain epsilon offsets have zero duration.
source_observer_metadata.residence_definition: Accepted-path intersection with outside-stack cylinder radius max(5 m,2*diameter), outlet orthometric height +/-5 m. This model does not resolve an in-pipe jet or in-pipe residence. Returning entries include aged parcels crossing from outside, not just newborn particles.
source_observer_metadata.daily_surface_pools: daily_surface_pools/day_DD_end.npz; actual day-end states, not daily averages (provided for benchmark and production)
source_observer_metadata.temporal_support: Regional fields are full-count hourly endpoint mass. Collar residence is selected-path time support within each 30 s step. They are distinct diagnostics; a visual crossfade does not form a conservative concentration field. Display expansion factor is not actual parcel mass.

units: micrograms/m3 for expanded selected-path hourly residence density; actual selected mass*time separately stored in kg*s
sampling_warning: Fixed-ID systematic subset, not full-count trajectories or an unbiased random sample. Expansion is a display-estimator weight, not added physical mass. Final24h use8 actually replayed member IDs instead of1; each frame declares its own expansion factor. This improves diagnostic sampling only, not the native full-count concentration or the30s path resolution.
temporal_support: Near hourly accepted-path residence, different from regional full-count hourly endpoints. Spatial visual partition is not one conservative concentration field.
cell_geometry: Exact straight-piece intersections with horizontal nonuniform faces and piecewise quadratic AGL surfaces over unchanged bilinear model terrain. Bins are no finer than the documented outlet diameter; the30s point-release model does not resolve an in-pipe jet.
